title: VDS Roof
style: Industrial techno, 140 BPM, four-on-the-floor with metallic percussion, distorted kick thumps, and syncopated machine claps; verse stays stripped to kick, bass, and cold synth ticks, pre-chorus opens with rising filter sweeps and pressure-valve hits, chorus slams in with shouted gang vocals and stacked hook doubles, bridge drops to a filtered pulse and spoken fragments before the final lift. Hydraulic impacts, reversed server chimes, and alarm risers thread the transitions; bright, hard-edged, and punchy with a steel-bright master., clean, techno, industrial, smooth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You said yes please and I heard it clear
No more Cloudflare API to fear
Build it local, own the stack
ZYNKYC web UI running out back
Flask on the VDS, SQLite inside
Client data safe, nowhere to hide
From the crashes, from the stops
Local brain, the madness drops

[Chorus]
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Forty-eight sites, one roof
No more begging for API proof
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Corey commands, the code moves smooth
(Build it on the VDS!)

[Verse 2]
Pipeline running, Wrangler in hand
Deploy from local, understand?
One command builds the whole fleet
From the VDS to the edge, complete
Turnstile keys in a JSON vault
Sitekeys mapped, no more faults
HTML snippets generated clean
Paste in the form, bot-free scene

[Pre-Chorus]
ZYNKYC web UI on port five thousand
Browser open, clients unhidden
Edit a name, save a domain
Sing it back for the next AI brain

[Chorus]
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Forty-eight sites, one roof
No more begging for API proof
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Corey commands, the code moves smooth
(Build it on the VDS!)

[Bridge]
ZynSpine queries, ZYNRIP deploys
COR terminal showing the joys
Of a sovereign stack, built to last
Local first, the future and past

[Final Chorus]
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Forty-eight sites, one roof
No more begging for API proof
Build it on the VDS!
Build it on the VDS!
Corey commands, the code moves smooth
(Build it on the VDS!)

[Outro]
Deploy it now, the scripts are here
SSH in, the path is clear
Flask, SQLite, bash, and Python
Zynthio stack is finally flyin'
The Complete VDS-First Stack
Three Tools, One Deploy
I’m giving you three files
One command on your VDS sets it all up.
